context: A boss briefs his manager on supplier diversification
purpose: Teach: 放出/談合/次長/書房/三菱/東芝/ブロガー/ベイ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ケンジくん、調達の件、三菱と東芝の比較資料、揃った？
lines.en: Kenji, the comparison materials for Mitsubishi and Toshiba — you have everything pulled together?
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. Expectant pause before the question. No wasted breath. The tone of someone who already knows the answer is yes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次長の指示で、ベイエリアの新興企業も二社追加しました。
lines.en: Yes. At the deputy's request, I added two emerging companies from the Bay Area as well.
lines.style: Even-paced, matter-of-fact. Light emphasis on 「追加」—showing initiative without over-claiming it. Professional and straightforward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良し。在庫の放出スケジュール、業界紙のブロガーにリークされないようにな。
lines.en: Good. Just make sure that inventory release schedule doesn't get leaked to industry-paper bloggers.
lines.style: Slightly lowered tone on the caution. Weight on 「リークされないように」—not a threat, but a clear instruction. Brief pause before the instruction lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しています。前回の談合疑惑の件もあり、情報管理は厳重にしています。
lines.en: Understood. The collusion allegations from last time mean we're running tight information control.
lines.style: Calm, assured delivery. Shows competence without defensiveness. Voice level steady—reassurance through competence, not emotion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 参考資料、岩波書房の業界年鑑も入れておいてくれ。
lines.en: For reference, make sure to include the Iwanami industry yearbook in there.
lines.style: Specific, almost an afterthought but delivered with precision. The tone of someone who remembers the detail that matters. Brief, clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 追加しておきます。次長会議は明日午後でよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: I'll add that in. Does tomorrow afternoon work for the deputy meeting?
lines.style: Efficient, wrapping-up energy. Slight upward lift on the question—confirming the logistics. No hesitation, just moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief, warm close. The 「頼む」softens slightly with trust. Not curt—just the economy of a good working relationship. Eye contact, slight nod.
